Inside, newer luxury vinyl plank flooring creates a warm, updated feel and flows through the main living areas. The bright living space features plenty of natural light and leads into a generously sized kitchen with abundant cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and plenty of room to cook, gather, and entertain.

One of the home's most convenient features is first-floor laundry, making everyday living just a little easier. With three bedrooms and two full bathrooms, there's flexibility for a home office, guest space, hobbies, or whatever fits your lifestyle.

Outside, step onto the rear deck and enjoy a surprisingly generous yard with room for gardening, pets, recreation, or summer get-togethers. A storage shed provides additional space for lawn equipment, bikes, and outdoor gear.

Whether you're a first-time home buyer, looking to downsize, or simply searching for an affordable home in Warsaw, this property delivers a lot of opportunity for the price.

At $159,900, this is one you'll want to see in person. Schedule your showing and come discover everything this Warsaw home has to offer! Negotiations may begin anytime after 5pm on Monday September 28th, 2026
